title: 第14章 那还说啥了？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

胡阿三走后没多久，天就黑了下来，虽然很不习惯，但张宁还是简单洗漱过后，就躺在了床上。

但脑子却没有闲着。

钱家每隔一段时间，就会消失几名下人，这到底是怎么回事？

难道钱家有什么杀人取乐的变态？

还是有什么见不得人的秘密？

以及，怎么才能把荒山县的人口，在最短的世间内，突破到一万以上？

仅凭自己生孩子，肯定是不行的。

先不说生孩子的周期太长。

荒山县压根就没这个条件！

除去5000驻军外，荒山县的实际人口，只有3343人，扣除老人、男人、真正能生育的妇女，又有几个？

而且，自己也不愿当一个只会配种的种马！

当然，若是有今日在钱家，所见那惊鸿一瞥的美女，愿意跟自己生孩子的话，那倒是另当别论了。

只是这样的女子，荒山县能有一个就不错了。

嗯……若所料不错的话，那女子极有可能，就是钱世康口中的嫂嫂。

除此之外，还可以吸引流民。

这也是为什么，张宁要在明日午时放粮的原因。

荒山县惨成这样，定边府下辖的其他县，恐怕也不会好到哪去，若是得知，荒山县每日放粮，必定会让许多活不下去的可怜百姓，对荒山县趋之若鹜。

但，古代消息太过闭塞，这消息也不知道，要过多久，才能传到其他县域。

这也不行，那也不行，难道老子还要出去抢人不成？

“砰砰砰。”

就在这时，一阵敲门声从门外响起，紧接着，凝香略显颤抖的声音，便传了过来，“殿，殿下，您睡了吗？”

“是凝香啊，进来吧。”

“嘎吱。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Not long after Hu Asan left, it got dark. Although he was not used to it, Zhang Ning simply washed up and lay on the bed.

But my mind was not idle.

Every once in a while, several servants of the Qian family disappear. What is going on?

Is there some kind of pervert in the Qian family who kills people for fun?

Or is there some dirty secret?

And, how can we increase the population of Huangshan County to more than 10,000 in the shortest time possible?

It is definitely not possible to give birth to a child on your own.

Not to mention that the cycle of giving birth is too long.

Huangshan County doesn’t have this condition at all!

Excluding the 5,000 garrison, the actual population of Huangshan County is only 3,343. Excluding the elderly, men, and truly fertile women, how many are there?

Moreover, I don’t want to be a stallion who can only breed!

Of course, if the beautiful woman he saw at Qian's house today was willing to have a child with him, that would be a different matter.

It's just that it would be great to have such a woman in Huangshan County.

Hmm... If the prediction is correct, that woman is most likely the sister-in-law Qian Shikang mentioned.

In addition, it can also attract refugees.

This is also the reason why Zhang Ning wants to put out grain at noon tomorrow.

With Huangshan County in such a miserable state, other counties under the jurisdiction of Dingbian Prefecture will probably not fare much better. If it is known that Huangshan County releases grain every day, many poor people who cannot survive will definitely flock to Huangshan County.

However, the news in ancient times was too limited, and it was not known how long it would take for this news to spread to other counties.

This won't work, that won't work either. Do I still want to go out and rob people?

"Bang bang bang."

At this moment, a knock on the door sounded from outside, and then Ningxiang's slightly trembling voice came over, "Your Highness, are you asleep?"

"It's Ningxiang, come in."

"Crunch."
